county_election_office.hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM, except the special hours in Notes for Oct 28 to Nov 1. Citywide: 1-866-VOTE-NYC (1-866-868-3692).

zip_caveats: All Staten Island ZIPs (103xx) are in Richmond County, so every voter here gets the same county races. NY-11 also covers southwest Brooklyn, and SD 23 and AD 61 also reach into other boroughs. Within Staten Island, your ZIP does not decide your districts; your street address does. Every voter here is in NY-11 for U.S. House. ONE of these State Senate races: SD 23, 24. ONE of these Assembly races: AD 61, 62, 63, 64. A Civil Court municipal-district race is on the ballot only in the 1st Municipal Court District this year; elsewhere in the borough you won't see one. Your exact ballot: enter your address at findmypollsite.vote.nyc. ZIP lists are standard USPS residential ZIPs for the borough, compiled for this guide, not an official Board of Elections crosswalk.

notes: Need a mail ballot in person? Go to your borough election office by Monday, Nov 2.
